title: Shipped: recursive summarisation and knowledge-base curation (exploratory)
description:
Ryan intends Shipped to roll summaries up recursively: item summaries feed topic summaries, topics feed trends, trends feed story ideas. Curation should be driven by its knowledge base.

The vision is not settled. Explore it once Shipped has a real reference feed; today it has seed content and no monitor.

Revisit after the idea pipeline v0 (PPY-8ffc18) has been tried on the Anthus sites.

No acceptance criteria yet.
